title: 高深寬比介電層蝕刻
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究介電堆疊、輸運與充電、輪廓控制、端點與功能；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: dielectric stacks, transport and charging, profile control, endpoint and function. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

steps.instruction:

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設介電孔深 1000 nm，孔口 100 nm，中段最大孔徑 120 nm，孔底最小孔徑 60 nm。以孔口計 AR=10，但以最小孔徑計有效幾何比為 16.7；中段相對孔口膨脹 20%。在同一截面標出三個量測位置，不能只用孔口照片宣告全孔垂直與等寬。
steps.instructionEn:
Measure opening, maximum bow and bottom. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: One width cannot characterize bowing.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume a 1000 nm deep dielectric hole with 100 nm opening, 120 nm maximum mid-depth diameter and 60 nm minimum bottom diameter. Opening-based AR is 10, while the minimum-diameter ratio is 16.7; mid-depth bow is 20% relative to the opening. Mark all three sites in one section rather than declaring a straight, uniform hole from an opening image.

交付 10、16.7、20% 與三位置截面標記。
